The journal holds the grants and their granted_by, never the words that asked for them, so a reader has the builder's word for the direction and the node's word for the grant.
who passed the name principal:bdo: nothing in the node, the export, this report or the witness authenticates it.

a registry entry for the model that ran the act: contracts/principals.json describes principal:claude-fable-5-1 as the model the host serves, which stopped being true when the serving model changed to Claude Opus 5 partway through this session by Bdo's own /model command. Minting an entry is identity naming and owner-held, so none was minted; the stale claim stands in the registry and is named here and at the pull request rather than repaired.

the direction as a node record: open-office could append it as an entry the node keeps, which would put the words beside the grants they asked for. That changes a shape the Console Service records, so it crosses out of this concern's service into that contract and is not taken here.
